errors.text_span: Третият по големина, в червено, е „5–10%“ с 14.3%. Четвъртият, в зелено, е „15–20%“ с 19%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly ranks the slices by size. It states the red slice (14.3%) is the third largest and the green slice (19%) is the fourth largest. In fact, the green slice (19%) is the third largest, and the red slice (14.3%) is the fourth largest.
